discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: server_token ###: Create a new application here and don't forget to link it to your server and allow access to private channels you specify bellow: https://discord.com/developers/applications
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: command_prefix ###: Prefix to use to call the bot - Empty to not have any prefix
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pri: Discord channel to ask private and public command - Empty to not have private command handling
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pub: Discord channel to ask public command - Empty to not have public command handling
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pri: Discord channel where where periodic task will show private and public status issue - Empty to not have public status issue channel
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pub: Discord channel where periodic task will show public status issue - Empty to not have public status issue channel
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pri: Discord channel where periodic task will show all private info periodically (spam channel) - Empty to not have periodic private channel info
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF: channel_name_for_pub: Discord channel where periodic task will show all public info periodically (spam channel) - Empty to not have periodic public channel info
discord_config.### EXPLANATION OF ALL: welcome_message_: Message to show when the bot is started specific channel - Empty to not have any message - if not empty and no message sent, it means there is an issue with the bot configuration (no access, ...) so you can check the logs to see what's wrong

basic_config.### EXPLANATION ###: Thresholds for system monitoring alerts. Warning values trigger alerts; critical values indicate severe issues.

scheduled_tasks_check_for_issues.### EXPLANATION ###: Periodic task that monitors for system issues. duration_in_sec_before_first_execution: wait before starting; duration_in_sec_wait_between_each_execution: interval between checks.

scheduled_tasks_show_infos.### EXPLANATION ###: Periodic task that broadcasts system information. duration_in_sec_before_first_execution: wait before first run (86400 = 1 day); duration_in_sec_wait_between_each_execution: repeat interval.

periodic_channel_cleanup.### EXPLANATION ###: Automatically clean up messages in specified channels. duration_in_sec_before_first_execution: wait before first cleanup; duration_in_sec_wait_between_each_execution: repeat interval (604800 = 7 days).

channels.description: Auto-clean command channel, keep messages from last 7 days
Auto-clean info channel, keep messages from last 30 days

websites.display_name: Bearer auth website (no mock, will fail)

certificates.display_name: Example of requested 4000 days certificate (for error catching example only)

recent_user_connections.### EXPLANATION ###: Monitor recent SSH/user logins. Set allow_all: false and specify allowed_ips to restrict alerts to specific sources. max_days limits how far back to check.

update.command: sudo /usr/bin/apt-get update -q >/dev/null && { output=$(/usr/bin/apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -E 'upgradable from'); if [ -z "$output" ]; then /usr/bin/echo "Packages already updated"; else /usr/bin/echo "$output"; fi; }

certificates.command: output=$(sudo /usr/bin/certbot renew --quiet --renew-hook '/usr/bin/echo "\nCertificat ${RENEWED_LINEAGE} mis à jour (ce qui met à jour les noms de domaines suivants: ${RENEWED_DOMAINS})\n" >&2'); if [[ -n "$output" ]]; then /usr/bin/echo "Service FTP relancé car dépend des certificats"; sudo /etc/init.d/proftpd restart >/dev/null 2>&1; else /usr/bin/echo "All certificates are already up to date"; fi
